faqSnippet.intro: A quick look at what dermatology practices ask before working with us. Need more detail? The full FAQ has everything.

timeline.q: How long does it take to launch a new practice site?
timeline.a: Most projects go live in 4–6 weeks — from discovery to launch. Timelines depend on content readiness and scope, and we share a clear week-by-week roadmap during onboarding.

hipaa.q: Do you handle HIPAA compliance and patient privacy?
hipaa.a: Yes. Every build is HIPAA-aware: secure hosting, encrypted forms, BAA-ready integrations for contact and intake, and a compliance review before launch.

ranking.q: Will my new website actually help me rank on Google?
ranking.a: SEO is engineered in from day one — dermatology-specific schema, service and location pages, Core Web Vitals of 95+, and an on-page structure built to earn rankings for the searches that drive bookings.

migration.q: Can you migrate my existing site without losing traffic?
migration.a: We run a zero-downtime migration with full 301 redirect mapping, preserved metadata, and a post-launch crawl audit — so rankings and referral traffic carry over cleanly.

support.q: What does ongoing support look like after launch?
support.a: You get a dedicated point of contact, monthly reporting, continuous CRO and SEO tuning, plus technical maintenance — so the site keeps compounding results, not going stale.
